analysis_used: Four separate complete 17-test Benjamini–Hochberg families are used for site, photoperiod, latitude, and site-versus-latitude adequacy.

analysis_used: Marginal and conditional R², participant-associated share, and non-overlapping term part-R² summaries use 1,000 successful joint bootstrap refits and 95% intervals.

analysis_used: Gaussian fixed-effect comparisons use maximum likelihood; final Gaussian estimation uses REML where applicable.

analysis_used: Dose is time-sensitive and retained only with the approved interval support.

analysis_used: The analysis uses the verified R 4.6.1 project library and pinned contemporary package APIs.

analysis_used: Participant-days with more than 1,440 valid light-signal minutes are excluded before metric modelling.

registered_or_expected: The label implied a single three-hour window before sleep.
analysis_used: The outcome is calendar-day cumulative time below 10 lx melEDI across every diary-defined pre-sleep interval; values strictly above six hours trigger an audit warning but are not capped.

analysis_used: The primary conversion subtracts 24 hours only for values strictly after 16:00; the noon cut is a registered same-row sensitivity.
